_comment: A LASA ticket claims file (lasa-core.md §4.3). Remove every _comment before minting; iat is stamped by mint.
_comment_aud: aud MUST equal the space id: [a-z0-9-], 1-128 chars. Tickets for another space are rejected.
_comment_exp: exp is epoch seconds and the only bound on reuse. Omit and pass --exp 24h to mint, or set it here.

panaudia._comment_client_id: The connecting client's id; its connection config must carry the same value.
panaudia._comment_roles: Base-profile roles: admin, presenter, moderator, producer, audience. Empty means audience.
panaudia._comment_permissions: Explicit state-access grants by key prefix, union'd with what the roles allow.
panaudia._comment_entities: Signed entity definitions; the client instantiates them by id in its setups.
